# Stdio and Streamable HTTP expose one shared MCP registry beside REST and the web UI.
env MINA_FX_AUTO_LOAD_ENABLED=false
env MINA_API_KEY=mina_EQO-K-an_paG-dFq7gSKeFafj2rI-41q2FCg2TZVpqO1hHBqwKXI
env TEST_MINA_API_KEY=mina_EQO-K-an_paG-dFq7gSKeFafj2rI-41q2FCg2TZVpqO1hHBqwKXI
env TEST_MINA_API_KEY_PREFIX=EQO-K-an
env TEST_OTHER_MINA_API_KEY=mina_Tq0BQrfy_-PztWjSGp7yFdphXUu9HqhmdYRnPnh1Wky3iP-OU8qw
freeport
exec mina --config-file mcp-config.toml serve --demo --db $WORK/mcp.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --access-log $WORK/mcp-access.log &server&
httpwait -timeout 15s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health

# Authentication failures and bearer credentials stay out of process access logs.
httpget -method POST -status 401 -body invalid-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
stdout '"code":"unauthenticated"'

# External MCP rejects an absent key before protocol dispatch.
httpget -status 401 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp
stdout '"code":"unauthenticated"'

# A valid browser session cookie is not an MCP credential.
httpget -save-cookie-env MCP_BROWSER_SESSION -method POST -body valid-login.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/auth/login
stdout '"authenticated":true'
httpget -cookie-env MCP_BROWSER_SESSION -method POST -status 401 -accept 'application/json, text/event-stream' -body initialize.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp
stdout '"code":"unauthenticated"'

# Stdio lists representative tools and leaves annotation assertions to the script.
mcplist stdio http://127.0.0.1:$PORT
stdout '^transport=stdio tool=transactions_list read_only=true destructive=false idempotent=true open_world=false$'
stdout '^transport=stdio tool=accounts_delete read_only=false destructive=true idempotent=true open_world=false$'
stdout '^transport=stdio tool=accounts_get '
stdout '^transport=stdio tool=members_create '

mcpcall stdio http://127.0.0.1:$PORT transactions_list '{"limit":5}'
stdout '"status":200'
stdout '"transactions":\['

# Streamable HTTP lists and calls tools through the same listener.
mcplist http http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp
stdout '^transport=http tool=transactions_list read_only=true destructive=false idempotent=true open_world=false$'
stdout '^transport=http tool=accounts_delete read_only=false destructive=true idempotent=true open_world=false$'

mcpcall http http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp accounts_get '{"account_id":8}'
stdout '"status":200'
stdout '"account_id":8'
stdout '"fqn":"bank:Chase:joint_checking"'

! mcpcall http http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp members_create '{"body":{"name":""}}'
stderr '"code":"invalid_request"'
stderr '"message"'

mcpcall http http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp members_create '{"body":{"name":"MCP Smoke Member"}}'
stdout '"status":201'
stdout '"member_id":'

# Non-loopback origins stay forbidden on Streamable HTTP.
httpget -bearer-env MINA_API_KEY -method POST -status 403 -accept 'application/json, text/event-stream' -origin https://example.com -body initialize.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp
stdout 'Forbidden: Origin must be loopback'

# REST and the web UI remain reachable on the same listener.
httpget http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
stdout '"status":"ok"'
httpget -accept text/html http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/
stdout '<div id="root"></div>'

# CLI revocation changes persisted state while the running server retains its startup snapshot.
exec mina --config-file mcp-config.toml auth api-key revoke $TEST_MINA_API_KEY_PREFIX
httpget -bearer-env TEST_MINA_API_KEY http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/settings
stdout '"groups"'
kill -INT server
wait server
! grep 'highly-visible-secret' $WORK/mcp-access.log
! grep $MINA_API_KEY $WORK/mcp-access.log

# Persisted key revocation takes effect after restart and fails before MCP dispatch.
freeport
exec mina --config-file mcp-config.toml serve --db $WORK/mcp.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &revoked_server&
httpwait -timeout 15s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
httpget -bearer-env TEST_MINA_API_KEY -status 401 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp
stdout '"code":"unauthenticated"'
httpget -bearer-env TEST_OTHER_MINA_API_KEY http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/settings
stdout '"groups"'
kill -INT revoked_server
wait revoked_server

# Authentication-disabled Streamable HTTP reaches MCP protocol dispatch without credentials.
freeport
exec mina serve --db $WORK/mcp-disabled.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &disabled_server&
httpwait -timeout 15s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
httpget -method POST -accept 'application/json, text/event-stream' -body initialize.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/mcp
stdout '"jsonrpc":"2.0"'
kill -INT disabled_server
wait disabled_server
